content:
Apple's annual most important product launch event is approaching, with over ten new products set to be unveiled in a short period. Here are five of the new Apple products I am most looking forward to.

iPhone Ultra

The first foldable iPhone is about to debut, offering the experience of both an iPhone and an iPad mini in a single device — truly exciting.

Even though a large amount of hardware details have already leaked, the software on the iPhone Ultra is what will determine whether the overall experience can truly excel. Therefore, I am very eager to see how Apple transforms iOS 27 into a system that natively runs on a foldable device, delivering more powerful features.

I have never used a foldable smartphone, but based on everything I have seen, this product form factor seems to be the future. Apple has clearly deliberated carefully before entering the foldable market, and I really hope this wait will be worthwhile.

HomePad

For years I have hoped Apple would take the smart home market seriously. It was not until Mark Gurman first reported in detail at the end of 2024 about the upcoming "HomePad" that I realised this shift was about to happen.

Every feature of the HomePad piques my interest, including Apple Photos slideshow playback, security camera functionality, Siri AI, and synchronised lyrics display when playing Apple Music, among others.

The delays to Siri AI have caused the HomePad launch to take longer than expected. But all signs point to an imminent release, and I am ready to witness Apple outline its vision for a new era of smart home living through the HomePad and other new home products.

All-new Apple TV 4K

The current Apple TV 4K has been on the market for four years. While this product does not need to be updated every year, the rise of AI technology offers enormous potential for a thorough revamp of the experience.

I am looking forward to seeing how Siri AI, a more powerful chip, and other hardware and software upgrades come together to make this Apple TV upgrade worthwhile.

The HomePad with a camera is set to launch around the same time as the new Apple TV 4K, and I am also very curious whether earlier rumours about a built-in camera model will come true. Being able to make FaceTime calls on a big screen in the future without needing to use an iPhone would be incredibly convenient.

MacBook Ultra

I have been using the iPad Pro as my primary computer for over a decade. One of the main reasons I made the switch in 2015 was that Macs had consistently lagged behind the iPad in terms of innovative software and hardware features.

After Apple Silicon chips were applied to the Mac, some of the issues were addressed to a certain extent, and macOS has increasingly been updated in sync with iOS and iPadOS. However, in many ways the Mac still feels stuck in the past rather than oriented towards the future.

I am hopeful that the MacBook Ultra will change this situation. Adding touch support, an OLED display, Dynamic Island, an all-new design, and even possibly a cellular version — each one is extremely appealing. This is the Mac update I have been waiting for, and I cannot wait to see the full picture Apple is about to unveil.

Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4

I have not yet decided whether to go for the Series 12 or the Ultra 4 this year. But regardless of which one I choose, I am very much looking forward to the new models — primarily because of one rumoured major upgrade: an all-new S-series chip designed for the AI era.

Apple Watch chips are not changed frequently. While Apple makes small improvements to the S-series chips every year, CPU performance only sees a significant boost roughly every three years. Therefore, the last major leap in chip performance was the S9 in 2023.

However, reports indicate that this year's watch models will feature a more powerful all-new chip — the first chip designed specifically for the AI era — and the timing could not be better, perfectly coinciding with the launch of Siri AI.

Which upcoming Apple product are you most looking forward to? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
